Before submitting a new or revised rule, run it on every received demo using the exact demo inputs and compare exact output grids; do not substitute a synthetic or approximate reconstruction for a demo. If a transcription or comparison is uncertain, resolve it before treating the rule as validated. Revise until all demos match, then run it on the test input and submit only that generated grid.
3. After the verdict, save the transform that reproduced all available demos to `programs/<task id>.py`, replacing an older version as needed. Issue `finish` only after the instance is over.
